instructions_to_main_agent: You are editing React .js files in /app/frontend/src/.
Import Google Fonts ('Syne' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans') in /app/frontend/public/index.html or /app/frontend/src/index.css.
Set up default mock product state in localStorage so user can edit, add, or delete products and retain changes.
Make sure every affiliate link button has target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' and 'data-testid' like data-testid='shopee-affiliate-btn-1'.
Add toast notifications via 'sonner' when a user copies a coupon code, shares a product link, or updates products in the admin panel.
Ensure responsiveness on mobile viewports with smooth mobile navigation menu drawer.
Include a 'Modo Admin' floating toggle button at bottom-right or header so the store manager can easily access product management.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, search inputs, modal triggers, category pills) MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure text contrast over dark obsidian backgrounds. Hover states must be clearly visible and lighter.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Framer Motion for entrance cards, button hover effects, glowing borders, and toast confirmation feedback.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_placeholders: Use real Unsplash URLs provided in this file. Never use placehold.it or broken links.
